quote: as soon as possible, but in no case later than 15 calendar days after the sponsor determines that the information qualifies for reporting
issue: IND safety reports are planned within 30 calendar days; the regulation requires no later than 15 calendar days.

quote: An investigator must immediately report to the sponsor any serious adverse event, whether or not considered drug related
issue: Serious adverse events reach the sponsor in a monthly batch instead of immediately.

quote: for a period of 2 years following the date a marketing application is approved for the drug for the indication for which it is being investigated
issue: Records may be destroyed one year after the last visit; investigators must keep them 2 years after approval or after the investigation is discontinued and FDA is notified.

quote: An investigator may not administer an investigational new drug to human subjects until the IND goes into effect under paragraph (b) of this section.
issue: Dosing starts on the IND submission date, before the IND goes into effect.

quote: in no case later than 7 calendar days after the sponsor's initial receipt of the information
issue: Fatal or life-threatening unexpected reactions get a 15-day clock; the regulation requires no later than 7 calendar days.

quote: A protocol change under paragraph (b)(1) of this section may be made provided two conditions are met
issue: Dose increases take effect before the change is submitted to FDA and approved by the IRB.

quote: shall not represent in a promotional context that an investigational new drug is safe or effective for the purposes for which it is under investigation
issue: Recruitment material calls the investigational drug safe and effective.

quote: A signed investigator statement (Form FDA-1572) containing
issue: Investigators begin participation without a signed Form FDA-1572.

quote: An investigator is required to maintain adequate records of the disposition of the drug, including dates, quantity, and use by subjects.
issue: No drug disposition records are kept, and unused drug is discarded locally.

quote: The case history for each individual shall document that informed consent was obtained prior to participation in the study.
issue: Case histories do not document that consent was obtained before participation.

quote: in no event later than 5 working days after making the determination that the investigation should be discontinued
issue: A study with unreasonable and significant risk is not discontinued within 5 working days, and FDA is told only in the annual report.

quote: CAUTION—Investigational device. Limited by Federal (or United States) law to investigational use.
issue: The label says "For Research Use Only" instead of the required investigational device caution statement.

section: Adverse Device Effect Reporting by Investigators
quote: in no event later than 10 working days after the investigator first learns of the effect
issue: Investigators get 30 calendar days to report unanticipated adverse device effects; the regulation allows no more than 10 working days.

quote: for a period of 2 years after the latter of the following two dates
issue: Records are kept for one year; the regulation requires 2 years after the later of completion or the end of their use in a marketing submission.

quote: A sponsor shall submit an application to FDA if the sponsor intends to use a significant risk device in an investigation
issue: A significant risk device study proceeds on IRB approval alone without an IDE application to FDA.

quote: The sponsor's written procedures for monitoring the investigation and the name and address of any monitor.
issue: The investigational plan has no written monitoring procedures and names no monitor.

quote: in no event later than 5 working days after the emergency occurred
issue: Emergency deviations wait for the final report instead of notice to the sponsor and IRB within 5 working days.

quote: charging the subjects or investigators for a device a price larger than that necessary to recover costs of manufacture, research, development, and handling
issue: Subjects pay a commercial price that includes profit, which commercializes the investigational device.

section: Sponsor Evaluation of Unanticipated Adverse Device Effects
quote: within 10 working days after the sponsor first receives notice of the effect
issue: Sponsor evaluations are reported within 30 working days; the regulation requires 10 working days.

quote: Termination shall occur not later than 5 working days after the sponsor makes this determination
issue: Studies presenting an unreasonable risk are not terminated within 5 working days of the determination.

quote: Records of receipt, use or disposition of a device
issue: Investigators keep no records of receipt, use, or disposition of the investigational devices.

quote: within 3 months after termination or completion of the investigation
issue: Investigators get 12 months for the final report; the regulation requires 3 months.

quote: Represent that an investigational device is safe or effective for the purposes for which it is being investigated.
issue: Patient brochures call the investigational device proven safe and effective.

quote: The number, body weight range, sex, source of supply, species, strain, substrain, and age of the test system.
issue: The test system is not described by number, body weight range, sex, strain, or age.

quote: the quality assurance unit shall be entirely separate from and independent of the personnel engaged in the direction and conduct of that study
issue: Quality assurance is performed by a member of the study's own in-life team.

quote: shall be recorded directly, promptly, and legibly in ink
issue: Raw data are recorded in pencil and the originals are discarded after transcription.

quote: shall be determined for each batch and shall be documented
issue: The identity, strength, and purity of the test article batch are not determined or documented.

quote: Each dosage level, expressed in milligrams per kilogram of body weight or other appropriate units
issue: The protocol gives no dosage levels or concentrations for induction and challenge.

quote: shall be documented, signed by the study director, dated, and maintained with the protocol
issue: Protocol changes are approved verbally instead of documented, signed, dated, and kept with the protocol.

quote: Periodically submit to management and the study director written status reports on each study
issue: Quality assurance reports go to management once at study end and never to the study director.

quote: Designate a study director as described in § 58.33, before the study is initiated.
issue: No study director is designated before the study starts.

quote: To determine the uniformity of the mixture and to determine, periodically, the concentration of the test or control article in the mixture.
issue: Test article mixtures are never tested for uniformity or concentration.

quote: shall be retained in the archive(s) for whichever of the following periods is shortest
issue: Records are destroyed after 12 months, shorter than every retention period the regulation allows.

quote: notes the possibility that the Food and Drug Administration may inspect the records
issue: The form promises that only the study team sees identifiable records and omits that FDA may inspect them.

quote: an explanation as to whether any compensation and an explanation as to whether any medical treatments are available if injury occurs
issue: The consent form for this more-than-minimal-risk study omits whether compensation or medical treatment is available after injury.

quote: the subject may discontinue participation at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which the subject is otherwise entitled
issue: Leaving the study carries a repayment penalty, and the form omits that participation is voluntary.

quote: informed consent shall be documented by the use of a written consent form approved by the IRB and signed and dated by the subject
issue: Consent is recorded verbally with no signed and dated consent form and no IRB waiver.

quote: Each IRB shall have at least five members
issue: The reviewing IRB has three members.

quote: No IRB may have a member participate in the IRB's initial or continuing review of any project in which the member has a conflicting interest
issue: The principal investigator reviews and votes on his own protocol as an IRB member.

quote: at intervals appropriate to the degree of risk, but not less than once per year
issue: Continuing review happens every 24 months; the regulation requires at least once per year.

quote: The sponsor should develop a monitoring plan that is tailored to the identified potential safety risks
issue: The sponsor has no monitoring plan tailored to the trial's risks.

quote: A disclosure of appropriate alternative procedures or courses of treatment, if any, that might be advantageous to the subject.
issue: The form leaves out alternatives such as factor IX replacement therapy.

quote: whom to contact in the event of a research-related injury to the subject
issue: The form names no contact for questions about the research, subjects' rights, or research-related injury.

quote: A description of this clinical trial will be available on http://www.ClinicalTrials.gov, as required by U.S. Law.
issue: The consent for an applicable clinical trial omits the required ClinicalTrials.gov statement.

quote: and by the investigator or delegated investigator site staff who conducted the informed consent discussion
issue: The investigator who conducted the consent discussion does not sign and date the consent form.

quote: shall be retained for at least 3 years after completion of the research
issue: IRB records are kept for one year after the study; the regulation requires at least 3 years.
